title: Planearby / Nearby aircraft radar
role: Planning / feature scoping / building with Codex Sol 6.1
introduction: I made this because I often wondered about the aircraft overhead while driving or exercising. It shows aircraft within 30 km using a radar and airport-style board, focusing on the nearby-aircraft lookup I used in Flightradar24. The project was built entirely with Codex Sol 6.1.
myWorks: Used my experience with Flightradar24 to scope the service around checking nearby aircraft
Built the dashboard, settings and location picker with Vue 3, Vite, JavaScript and SCSS
Created a responsive layout with the flight board beside the radar on desktop and the radar first on mobile
Implemented split-flap flight information, aircraft selection, refresh-aligned automatic switching and pause controls
Integrated Geolocation, adsb.lol and adsbdb for aircraft within 30 km and reference routes, refreshing every 5, 10 or 15 seconds based on network conditions
Added manual location selection through Leaflet / OpenStreetMap, address search and coordinate input
Supported light / dark themes, Korean / English / Japanese, linked mobile location and compass controls, and manual headings
Added keyboard navigation, status and radar-scale announcements, reduced motion, prerendered SEO and GitHub Pages deployment
achievements: Connected aircraft distance and bearing on the radar to readable details on the flight board
Added location permission retries, GPS and compass failure guidance, plus map and coordinate alternatives
Built request cancellation, route caching, API rate-limit waits and error states into the interface
points: Combined radar visualization with an airport flight board and split-flap interactions
Delivered responsive Vue UI with multilingual content, themes and accessibility
Screenshots show the service’s fictional aircraft examples, separate from live flight data
